stem: In a school garden in Jaipur, Meena observes a sparrow eating grains scattered on the ground and also catching small insects. The science teacher asks: how is the sparrow correctly classified according to how it obtains its food?

options.text: producer, because it lives in the garden where plants grow
omnivore, because it eats both plant material (grains) and animals (insects)
herbivore, because grains form the largest part of its diet
carnivore, because it catches and kills insects

teacher.key_rationale: The sparrow eats both grains (plant material) and insects (animals), so by how it obtains food it is an omnivore. It is not a producer (it cannot photosynthesise), not purely herbivore (it eats insects), and not purely carnivore (it eats grains).
